page.content:
January Tokyo Dome show — New Japan's WrestleMania.

How Wrestle Kingdom connects

  • Location: Tokyo Dome — Wrestle Kingdom is staged at the Tokyo Dome.
  • Topic: NJPW — Wrestle Kingdom is New Japan's January showcase.
  • Event: G1 Climax — Winning the G1 Climax books the Wrestle Kingdom main event.

What is Wrestle Kingdom?

Wrestle Kingdom is New Japan's January Tokyo Dome event, the year-turning card where IWGP titles change and the G1 winner cashes the main event.

Key threads lead to Tokyo Dome, NJPW and G1 Climax.
